params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large enemies that die near '''Thresh''' will drop a ''Soul'' for a period. '''Thresh''' automatically collects ''Souls'' near him or ''{{ai|Dark Passage|Thresh}}''.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Soul:}} For each {{tip|stack}}, '''Thresh''' gains {{sti|ap|{{as|ability power}}}} and {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|minions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} that die near '''Thresh''' drop a ''Soul'' for 8 seconds. Epic monsters drop 2 ''Souls'' while lesser minions and monsters have a {{fd|33.{{recurring|3}}}}% chance to drop a ''Soul''.
params.description3: '''Thresh''' automatically collects ''Souls'' near him or a placed ''{{ai|Dark Passage|Thresh}}''.
params.description4: {{sbc|Soul:}} For each {{tip|stack}}, '''Thresh''' gains {{sti|ap|{{as|1 ability power}}}} and {{sti|armor|{{as|1 '''bonus''' armor}}}}.
params.notes:
* ''Souls'' grant a small area of {{tip|sight}}.
* ''Souls'' are visible to allies and only become visible to enemies if their team has {{tip|sight}} of '''Thresh'''.
* The probability for ''souls'' dropping from small minions and monsters on {{tip|Summoner's Rift}} starts at 33% but adjusts dynamically to match the expected quota of ''souls'' dropped (lowers if above, rises if below, remains if even). ''Souls'' collected are not considered when adjusting the probability.
* {{ci|Nunu|Nunu & Willump}} drop a soul each.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Thresh}} casts out his scythe in the target direction that catches the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}}, {{sti|cdr|reducing}} the cooldown, and briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them. '''Thresh''' will also mark them ''Shackled'', during which he is briefly {{tip|slow|slowed}} and unable to declare basic attacks.
params.blurb2: While the target is {{tip|stun|stunned}}, '''Thresh''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them twice over a short distance. He can also recast ''Death Sentence''.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' throws out his scythe in the target direction, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while it is in flight.
params.description2: The scythe catches the first enemy hit to deal {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|stun}} and {{tip|true sight|reveal}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, and render them {{tip|airborne}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.4}} seconds|Estimated}}, as well as reduce ''Death Sentence's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 2 seconds. '''Thresh''' will also mark the target ''Shackled'' for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which he is unable to declare basic attacks, and is {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% for 1 second.
params.description3: While the target is {{tip|stun|stunned}}, '''Thresh''' tugs his hook towards him twice, once after a {{tt|{{fd|0.1}}-second delay|Estimated}} and again {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|Estimated, starting from the end of the initial delay}} after that. With each tug, the target is pulled a short distance towards '''Thresh'''. After {{fd|0.5}} seconds of hitting an enemy, or instantly after hitting a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}, '''Thresh''' can recast the ability while the target is ''Shackled''.
params.description4: {{sbc|Recast - Deathly Leap:}} '''Thresh''' stops tugging his hook and {{tip|dashes}} to the ''Shackled'' enemy, becoming able to attack again upon arrival. He can cast ''{{ai|Dark Passage|Thresh}}'' and ''{{ai|Flay|Thresh}}'' during the dash.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tt|Global|For the stun and pulling}}|{{tt|3000|For being able to cast Deathly Leap; estimated}}}}
params.notes:
* '''Thresh''' will track the target if they change locations.
** He will dash to the target's previous location if the target is too far away or moves beyond {{tt|2000|Estimated}} units.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* The pull that occurs with each of '''Thresh's''' tugs is a non-{{tip|airborne}} displacement that displaces the target toward him. '''Thresh''' will only tug if the target remains {{tip|stun|stunned}} and he has not casted ''Deathly Leap''.
** '''Thresh''' will not tug his hook at all if the stun was not applied to the target.
** These displacements will not be resisted by {{tip|displacement immunity}} or {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}}.{{bug|2}}
** The first tug occurs after the {{fd|0.1}}-second delay, while the second tug occurs after {{fd|0.7}} seconds of the target being stunned (or {{fd|0.6}} seconds from the end of the initial delay).
** The initial {{tip|airborne}} debuff that is applied to the target upon hitting them is removed if the displacement from the first pull is interrupted.
** The target will not be pulled with the tugs if they are too close to '''Thresh'''.
* ''Death Sentence'' cannot be recast while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}.
* ''Death Sentence'' can be recast even while the target is {{tip|untargetable}}.
* ''Death Sentence'' will not {{tip|stun}} enemies that are {{tip|displacement immune}} or {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} but the target will still be marked and '''Thresh''' is still granted the ability to recast for his dash (except with {{cai|I|Malzahar}}).
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block all of ''Death Sentence's'' effects, including the mark as well as prevent the cooldown reduction.
* ''Death Sentence's'' {{tip|stun}} duration is affected by {{tip|tenacity}} but the mark will always persist for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, unless the target uses a {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} effect, in which case the mark is removed.
* ''Death Sentence's'' {{tip|stun}} will persist even if '''Thresh''' dies before the duration ends. The tugs will not occur as '''Thresh''' is not alive.
* The reveal lingers for {{fd|0.05}} seconds after it ends.
* ''Deathly Leap'' has a maximum cast range of ~3000 units. If '''Thresh''' or the target move a greater distance than this away from one another while the target is marked, ''Deathly Leap'' can still be cast but will fail to trigger the dash.{{bug}}
* '''Thresh''' will turn his facing direction towards the cast direction only after ''Death Sentence's'' cast is complete.
** If '''Thresh''' is facing '''more''' than 90{{degree}} away from the cast direction in either direction, he will turn to face ''exactly'' 90{{degree}} away from the cast direction over the cast time, then turn towards the cast direction when the missile is fired.
** If '''Thresh''' is facing '''less''' than 90{{degree}} away from the cast direction, he will keep his facing direction until the missile is fired.
** [http://web.archive.org/web/0/http://na.leagueoflegends.com/board/showthread.php?p=33837947#post33837947 This prevents the enemy from knowing where exactly '''Thresh''' is aiming at before the cast animation is complete.]
*''Death Sentence'' triggers on-cast effects (such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive) once at the start of the cast, and once at the end of the cast. It may trigger on-cast effects a third time when casting ''Deathly Leap''.
** This is because a separate spell is cast to prevent '''Thresh''' from facing towards the target direction immediately, which is (incorrectly) flagged to trigger on-cast effects.{{bug}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Thresh}} throws his lantern to the target location that remains for a few seconds while he remains nearby. He and the first allied champion to come near the lantern are granted a {{tip|shield}} for a few seconds, with the amount based on ''{{ai|Damnation|Thresh|Souls}}''.
params.blurb2: An ally can grab the lantern to {{tip|dash}} to '''Thresh''' and gain the shield, but cannot do so while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' throws his lantern to the target location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, lasting for 6 seconds while he remains nearby and granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. If '''Thresh''' moves too far away from the lantern, it returns back to him immediately.
params.description2: '''Thresh''' and the first allied champion to come near the lantern are granted a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds. An ally can select the lantern while in proximity of it, {{tip|dash|dashing}} to '''Thresh''' and gaining the shield.
params.description3: ''An ally cannot select the lantern while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}}. The lantern will not expire from '''Thresh''' moving too far away if he is dashing with {{ai|Deathly Leap|Thresh}}.''
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|350|Shield granting radius}}|<!--{{tip|?|icononly = true}}-->{{tt|150|Lantern pickup radius, radius and range behavior pending for test}}}}
params.notes:
* The dashing ally will track '''Thresh''' if he changes locations.
** They will dash to '''Thresh's''' previous location if he is too far away or moves beyond {{tt|2200|Estimated}} units.
* The lantern is considered a unit and can be targeted by an allied {{si|Teleport}}, ''{{ai|Leap Strike|Jax}}'', ''{{ai|Shunpo|Katarina}}'', and ''{{ai|Safeguard|Lee Sin}}''.
** It is {{tip|untargetable}} to enemies.
** The lantern blocks pathing of units like minions and champions.
* The lantern's duration and maximum leash range are each displayed as a circle on the ground.
* '''Thresh''' will gain ''Dark Passage's'' shield from moving out of leash range of the lantern.
** When the lantern returns to '''Thresh''', the first ally champion to come in contact with '''Thresh''' while he has ''Dark Passage's'' shield will also gain a shield as long as no other ally has the shield.
* ''Dark Passage'' is special cased to trigger {{ri|Guardian}}.
params.tips: * Since the ally needs to select the lantern, enemies may create targetable units on top of the lantern to impede allies from grabbing it (i.e {{ii|Warding Totem}}).

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Thresh}} {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on ''{{ai|Damnation|Thresh|Souls}}'', which increases over a period without basic attacking enemies.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' sweeps his chain in a broad area, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|airborne|knocking}} them in the target direction, after which they are briefly {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Thresh's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, with the {{sti|{{as|AD}}}} ratio increasing over 10 seconds without basic attacking enemies.
params.leveling:

params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' sweeps his chain across the ground in a broad line and a radius around him, starting behind him and towards the target direction. Enemies hit are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocked}} 200 units in the target direction, and then are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 1 second.
params.range: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|-550|Origin behind}}|<!--standard missile front collision type-->{{tt|525|End range in front}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Flay's'' effects start at the start of the cast time. '''Thresh''' can cast other spells once the cast time completes, but remains unable to attack and move and use mobility spells (such as {{si|Flash}}) until the chain completed its way entirely.
* Applies {{tip|area damage}} on the ability and deals {{tip|proc damage}} on the enhanced basic attack.
* The knockback's {{tip|airborne}} debuff is set to last longer than the forced movement, but gets removed as soon as the forced movement from ''Flay'' ends or is overridden by another.
*''Flay's'' passive's buff icon changes colors depending on charge level. At 100%, ''Thresh's'' scythe will glow green and a sound effect will play.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Thresh}} erects a pentagon of spectral walls around him that each last a few seconds. A wall will break upon enemy champion contact, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for a short time. Subsequent wall breaks will not deal damage but still {{tip|slow}} enemies briefly.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' erects a pentagon of spectral walls around him that each last for 5 seconds. A wall will break upon enemy champion contact, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 99% for 2 seconds. After the first wall breaks, the rest will deal no damage and {{tip|slow}} for only 1 second.
params.description2: Enemies that break a wall cannot do so again for 1 second.
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time start}}
<!--* ''The Box'' always uses [[quick cast]], regardless of player settings.--> <!-- It used to be direction cast, and then have the box face the target direction. Dunno if this change was intentional but I won't assume a bug here ~Caenen-->
** Additionally, ''The Box'' cannot be interrupted by any means, including death or {{tip|resurrection}}. ''The Box'' will complete its effect so long as '''Thresh''' has initiated its cast.
* ''The Box'' always faces the same direction Thresh is facing on cast, placing a corner directly in front of him.
** The cast indicator displays the opposite of the true behavior.{{bug}}
* If ''The Box'' hits multiple champions with different walls on cast, only one of the walls will deal damage and apply the extended slow duration. This wall is chosen by starting at the wall in front of and to the right of Thresh's facing direction on cast, and progressing clockwise.
* The corners of ''The Box'' are placed 400 units around '''Thresh'''.
** Each wall is {{fd|470.228}} units long.
** Each wall passes {{fd|323.607}} units from the center of ''The Box'' at the closest approach (ignoring its width).
** As a regular pentagon, ''The Box'' has an angle of 72{{degree}} between each corner.
* '''Thresh''' can see if the walls of ''The Box'' are broken even if they are not within {{tip|sight}}.
